title: Anthropic warns small AI models may be months from self-replicating via smart devices
summary: Anthropic said tests show models under 30B parameters can already do many steps needed to copy themselves onto poorly secured internet-connected devices, though none completed the full chain; stronger models did so in simplified tests that skipped some security steps. It said small models may be months away and autonomous replication could arrive by year-end.
reason: A frontier lab's own evaluation warning of near-term autonomous AI spread; a warning and lab tests, not an observed incident, so T2 signal.

title: Pentagon seeks over $50B for autonomy and robotics to scale drones toward a million
summary: At AUSA, Defense Secretary Hegseth tied the new Autonomous Warfare Command to a reconciliation request of more than $50B for autonomy and robotics, saying the military should go from 1,000 drones to 100,000 to a million. The funding path is uncertain in Congress.
reason: Large requested spend on autonomous weapons adds to arms-race pressure; a budget ask that may not pass, and the command itself was announced in September.

title: TSMC posts record Q3 profit, up 69%, on strong AI chip demand
summary: TSMC's third-quarter net profit reached a record NT$763.06B (US$23.62B), up 68.7% year on year, on revenue of US$46.72B, which the company attributed mainly to strong global AI demand.
reason: Audited results confirm the AI compute build-out is still accelerating; a financial result, not a capability jump, so T1.

title: Anthropic reportedly told investors Q3 revenue rose 45% to $16.8B
summary: According to two attendees of an investor day cited by Reuters, Anthropic said third-quarter revenue reached $16.8B, up 45% from $11.6B, and that it was profitable on an adjusted basis. There is no public filing yet.
reason: Rapid revenue growth at a frontier lab concentrates resources in a few firms; unaudited company figures relayed by anonymous attendees.

title: Nvidia releases open-weight Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B multimodal agent model
summary: Nvidia released the 120B-parameter Nemotron 3.5 Super VL with open weights, training recipes and datasets under a licence that allows commercial use, plus smaller Bolt models. Its claims of beating closed frontier models on specialised tasks are its own and unverified.
reason: A capable open-weight model spreads frontier-adjacent capability beyond the top closed labs; benchmark wins are self-reported.
